extraction.name: AMASS: Archive of Motion Capture as Surface Shapes
extraction.description: AMASS is a large and varied database of human motion that unifies 15 different optical marker-based mocap datasets by representing them within a common framework and parameterization using the SMPL body model.
extraction.creator: Naureen Mahmood, Nima Ghorbani, Nikolaus F. Troje, Gerard Pons-Moll, Michael J. Black
extraction.rai:dataCollection: 15 existing motion capture datasets were combined into one large dataset. The publicly available datasets were downloaded from the internet, while others were obtained privately or recorded by the authors (e.g., the SSM dataset was recorded using an OptiTrack mocap system synchronized with a 3dMD 4D body scanning system). MoSh++ was used to map the marker data into common SMPL pose, shape, and soft-tissue parameters.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis, Physical data collection
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: During a mocap session, markers may get occluded by the body due to pose. If multiple markers of a particular body part are occluded simultaneously, the optimization may result in unreliable and implausible poses. To address this, a coefficient updates the pose prior weight as a factor of the number of missing markers.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Raw data consists of sparse optical motion capture markers from 15 datasets: ACCAD, BioMotion, CMU, EKUT, Eyes Japan, HumanEva, KIT, MPI HDM05, MPI Limits, MPI MoSh, SFU, SSM, TCD Hand, TotalCapture, and Transitions.
extraction.rai:dataImputationProtocol: In cases where there are no markers present on the hands of the recorded subjects, the hand poses are set to the average pose of the MANO model. For missing body markers, a missing-marker coefficient updates the pose prior weight as a factor of the number of missing markers.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: MoSh++ converts mocap data into realistic 3D human meshes represented by a rigged body model (SMPL). Due to inherent problems with mocap, such as swapped and mislabeled markers, the results were manually inspected and problems were either corrected or held out.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Manual inspection of the results to correct or hold out problems such as swapped and mislabeled markers.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The authors will continuously incorporate more mocap data contributed by them and the community.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Current runtime for MoSh++ is not real-time. Given a limited number of mocap markers, allowing more shape variation results in overfitting.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Animation, visualization, and generating training data for deep learning and computer vision tasks.
